integrity: The accompanying proof is self-contained and the standalone exhaustive verifier independently tests every labeled orientation through thirteen vertices at five rational edge weights; tests are finite corroboration rather than proof for every graph size.
scientific_limitations: Only simple cycle edge goods with identical positive symmetric incident-edge valuations, all but one weight one, and zero-inclusive EFX; no assertion of full weighted-graph enumeration, generic valuations, global publication-priority certification, or independent verification.
title: A one-edge perturbation removes a fixed fraction of fair cycle orientations
